questiontext.text: Why did the Neutrality Acts reflect isolationist sentiment?

answer.text: They attempted to keep Americans and American trade from drawing the nation into foreign wars.
They required the United States to join every European alliance.
They immediately declared war on Germany.
They transferred control of foreign policy to Britain.

questiontext.text: Which statement best explains the shift from neutrality to Lend-Lease?

answer.text: The United States increasingly aided nations resisting Axis aggression while remaining formally outside the war.
The United States ended all trade with Britain.
Congress surrendered its war powers to Germany.
The United States joined the Axis alliance.

questiontext.text: What did the Munich Agreement reveal about appeasement?

answer.text: Concessions did not prevent Hitler from pursuing further expansion.
It permanently ended German territorial demands.
It caused the United States to declare war in 1938.
It created the United Nations.

questiontext.text: Why is the Atlantic Charter historically significant?

answer.text: It expressed shared Anglo-American principles for the postwar world before formal U.S. entry.
It was the formal surrender of Japan.
It divided Germany into occupation zones.
It authorized Japanese American incarceration.
